newsitem.title: USA: Alliance Capital changes asset allocation model.
newsitem.headline: Alliance Capital changes asset allocation model.

text.p: Alliance Capital Management LP, which manages a variety of funds, said Friday it has increased the percentage of assets each fund may invest in U.S. dollar-denominated Russian sovereign debt obligations.
Under the change, each fund may invest up to 25 percent of its total assets in those those debt obligations. Previously, the funds were limited to either 5 percent or 10 percent of total assets.

The company manages ACM Managed Dollar Income Fund, Alliance World Dollar Government Fund, Alliance World Dollar Government Fund II, and Alliance Global Dollar Government Fund, which invest principally in U.S. dollar-dominated sovereign debt obligations of emerging market countries.
All of the funds are closed-end investment companies except for Global Dollar, which is an open-end investment company.
